description: Beta users must supply their uploaded asset_id and kind compute_job. No accuracy guarantee is made for uploaded files. Owner legacy calls can queue the fixed synthetic benchmark. compute_job returns a transcript; delegated_task additionally requires word error rate at most 10% against the known reference. Returns a job_id to poll with get_compute_job. No payment is charged. Reuse the same idempotency_key for retries, and use a new key only for a new job.

access_token.description: Temporary token returned by create_trial_access. Optional when Bearer authentication is configured.

asset_id.description: Owned upload ID returned by POST /v1/beta/upload. Required for public beta buyers.

idempotency_key.description: Unique request key. Keep it unchanged on retries.

kind.description: Transcription only, or transcription with the reference quality gate.

name: submit_compute_job
title: Submit an audio transcription job
